name_input: BANSWARA GARMENTS (A UNIT OF BANSWARA SYNTEX LIMITED)
export_evidence: Parent company's own published performance table (banswarasyntex.com/working-performance): "3 EXPORTS (Incl. Export Benefits) 325.00 551.00 581.00 570.00 568.00 580.00 526.00 605.00 599.00 531.34" (Rs. crore, FY2020-21 back to FY2011-12) — i.e. Rs 325.00 cr exports in FY2020-21 and Rs 551.00 cr in FY2019-20. Company profile page states: "we have forayed into markets in over 50 countries including the U.S., U.K., Canada, Spain, Germany, Japan, France, UAE, and Turkey" and "a government-recognized Three Star Export House". NOTE: these are consolidated figures for Banswara Syntex Ltd (all units), not unit-level B-L records for the Daman garment unit. No individual bill-of-lading number, shipment date, destination port or HS code line was retrievable: importkey.com/countries/india/banswara-garments-a-unit-of-banswara-syntex-limited returned a paywalled shell with 0 visible rows ("Loading...", "Number of shipments by month" chart empty); volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403; importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge. Source counter: 5 shipment-data sources attempted, 0 rows actually seen.
domestic_evidence: Parent is a listed public limited company (CIN L24302RJ1976PLC001684 per site footer) with audited domestic sales: "1 GROSS SALES 786.63 1289.5 1350.93 1,295.07 1,254.49 1270.99 1235.65 1230.76 1130.44 967.26" and "2 NET SALES 786.63 1289.5 1350.93" (Rs crore) — net sales exceed exports in every year, so the balance is domestic turnover. Site also lists a "Domestic Customers" section and a physical Daman plant: "Banswara Garments , (A Unit of Banswara Syntex Ltd) Survey No 85/3 & 4, 86/2, Kadaiya Industrial Estate, Kadaiya , Daman – 396210 INDIA." GSTIN-level turnover band and GeM/CPPP tender records were not retrieved (no public page found in this session).
note: Legal entity exists and is active: Banswara Garments is a unit of Banswara Syntex Ltd, a BSE-listed public limited company (CIN L24302RJ1976PLC001684), with a registered Daman garment plant at Kadaiya Industrial Estate. Shipments are factually evidenced at parent-company level by audited export figures (Rs 325.00 cr FY2020-21; Rs 551.00 cr FY2019-20) and by domestic net sales of Rs 786.63 cr / 1289.5 cr in the same years — so both export and domestic supply are real, not merely claimed. However, no unit-specific customs or bill-of-lading record (date, destination, HS code, B-L number) for the Daman unit could be opened: all four shipment databases tried were paywalled or blocked, so the exact B-L trail is null. HS codes declared (511290; 520812; 520822; 520839 — woven wool and cotton fabrics) are plausible for a vertically integrated textile mill, but the claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG) is wrong: the company is a textile/yarn/fabric/readymade-garment manufacturer. PAN AAACB8403F and state 'Daman and Diu' were not independently verified in this session (null). No rejection grounds: entity is neither non-existent, liquidated nor bankrupt.
